verses.1: A message for David to remember.
verses.2: May the LORD, in your power, make me strong; and in your warmth, may you support me.
verses.3: For your hands have touched me, and they have rested on me.
verses.4: There is no peace in my words due to your anger; there is no healing in my heart due to my sins.
verses.5: For my sorrows have passed away; my head is now free from them. They have been taken away from me.
verses.6: The man removed my bonds from before me.
verses.7: I’ve been beaten and humiliated to the point of exhaustion today. Every day, I’m forced to endure this suffering.
verses.8: For my chest is filled with bitterness, and there’s nothing left in my flesh.
verses.9: I was overwhelmed with sorrow and pain to the extreme. I cried out from the depths of my heart.
verses.10: My hatred for you is complete; my sorrow and despair towards you are not hidden at all.
verses.11: My heart is filled with sorrow; my strength has left me. Even my eyes no longer see anything.
verses.12: My friends and enemies stand opposite each other; those who are close to me stand far away from me.
verses.13: And those who seek to harm my soul and cause me sorrow, they speak lies and deceit every day.
verses.14: And I am like a wild animal; I cannot hear, and he refuses to open his mouth.
verses.15: And the Lord is like a man who does not listen, and there is no wisdom in him at all.
verses.16: For You, LORD, I have begun to serve; You shall answer me, O God my Lord.
verses.17: For I said, “May they not rejoice for me when my feet are on the ground.”
verses.18: For I am always in pain and suffering, against my will.
verses.19: Since you have led me astray, I will confess my sins.
verses.20: And their lives are filled with suffering, and their hatred for the truth is great.
verses.21: And from evil to good, they will humble me under their control. They will put me in a position of power over me.
verses.22: Do not abandon me, LORD my God; do not withdraw from me.
verses.23: May You, O God of my help, be my savior.
